_comment: Illustrative runner pools. 'admission' is the pool's concurrency limit and 'warm_pool' the pre-provisioned runner count (the latency-for-money trade Machine Runner Orchestrator's minReplicas expresses). 'admission_mode' records who is allowed onto the pool: this is a safety field, and the simulator refuses to construct a self-hosted pool admitted to untrusted fork code.

pools.note: Provider-hosted ARM resources, billed per minute. No fleet to own.
Ephemeral self-hosted ARM runners, one job each. Trusted code only.
Ephemeral pods in a cluster; torn down after each job.
Full VM per job, pre-warmed pool. Strongest isolation, slowest cold path.
Long-lived machine. Retained because it is the shape to argue against.
